basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Commercial Analytics & AI Engineer · GTM Measurement · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Engineer and MBA who turns commercial data into shipped decisions. Built AI Brain at LumApps, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes that drives strategy across product, sales, and CS. At Beekeeper co-owned GTM launches across multiple segments and products with instrumentation that proved (or killed) the bet within a week. Founder of three companies including PulseView, a consumption-based AI market intelligence platform. Comfortable in Python and SQL, fluent across LLM systems, and energized by ambiguous environments where the measurement framework does not yet exist.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end. Builds the measurement and context layer that turns commercial data into actionable strategy.
highlights: Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Surfaces business patterns and sized opportunities that drive strategy across product, sales, and CS.

Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales, instrumented end-to-end. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day; forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter.
Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who shipped AI-powered products to 10M+ users across multiple segments. Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales, every release instrumented so the bet was proven or killed quickly.
highlights: Co-owned GTM launches across multiple segments and products (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Employee Referral, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing and ranking using behavioural signals; measurable lift in user engagement.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR) with continuous funnel analysis driving roadmap.
Built ClickHouse-backed analytics surfaces for product and CS teams; informed activation, expansion, and retention decisions across the customer lifecycle.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates analytics maturity, AI adoption, and commercial measurement frameworks.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, AI readiness, and analytics maturity to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored portfolio companies on building data-informed product and GTM decision frameworks.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built every layer of the stack including the analytics that drove iteration.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ deliveries, every flight instrumented with flight, safety, and delivery metrics that drove product iteration.
Engineered logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Research engineer on Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems. Heavy use of experimentation, fitness landscapes, and statistical analysis.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Rigorous experimental design on fitness landscapes, optimization, and learning from environment.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel experiments impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time AI market intelligence on a consumption-based pricing model. AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals using technical and news-based data, built for explainability over complexity.

Core product principle: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Explainability over complexity.

highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Customer cohort analysis drove a 40% uplift in satisfaction.
Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features.

Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: GTM Data Scientist owning measurement and analysis across the commercial customer lifecycle (new logo acquisition, activation, expansion, retention) for a rapidly scaling consumption-based AI platform. Heavy on causal inference (controlled experiments, synthetic controls), A/B testing, statistical modeling. Python, SQL, viz tools. 5+ years preferred, multi-segment B2B commercial analytics, AI/ML product experience. Hybrid 25% in NY or SF, visa sponsored. $275k-$370k USD.
_jobApplication.notes: Stretch fit. Candidate is engineer/MBA, not a pure data scientist. No explicit causal inference / synthetic controls / A/B testing publications or formal experience to point to. Lean angle: shipped commercial analytics in practice (AI Brain context layer, Beekeeper GTM instrumentation, Search Platform measurement, PulseView consumption-based pricing). Genuine interest in Anthropic's mission worth showcasing in cover note. Visa + location (Zurich to NY/SF hybrid 25%) need addressing. May want to consider whether to apply or aim at a GTM-AI-engineering role at Anthropic instead.
